Our senior planner on travel paperwork
The purpose of this section is to describe what the desk expects

Companion Animal Travel Desk

The Companion Animal Travel Desk supports passengers who are traveling with companion animals and keeps each record clear, calm, and complete. Staff members should greet every traveler in a warm professional tone, listen with care, and record the details needed for smooth handling of the request. When a traveler brings up a concern, the reply should be prompt and respectful, and the note should reflect only what was said and what was agreed.

The desk should check forms, travel needs, and any supporting papers for completeness before moving a file forward. If something is missing, staff should explain the gap in simple language and guide the traveler toward the next step without pressure. The desk should avoid guessing, and it should never promise an outcome that has not been confirmed through the proper review. If a pet such as Mia is mentioned in the file, the record should stay factual and easy to follow.

Staff should keep communication steady and courteous across every touchpoint, whether the traveler is calling, writing, or standing at the counter. Internal notes should be brief, legible, and useful for the next person who opens the file. Careful records help Aurelia Skyways support safe and orderly travel for companion animals while keeping the traveler informed and at ease.

When a situation falls outside normal desk practice, staff should pass it to the senior coordinator or the appropriate service lead and make a clear note of the handoff. For questions about this section, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
